test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 14th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the correct option: The minister’s report was filled with warnings, none of ____ were clarified.
solution:
The correct answer is '**which**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**which**" is a relative pronoun used to refer to the warnings in the sentence.
 
• The sentence structure requires a relative pronoun to connect the dependent clause to the main clause.
 
• **Options 1, 2,** and **4** are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The minister’s report was filled with warnings, none of **which**__ were clarified."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "that"** is incorrect because it cannot refer back to the noun "warnings" in this sentence structure.
 
• **Option 2: "them"** is incorrect because it is a pronoun, not a relative pronoun, and cannot connect clauses.
 
• **Option 4: "whom"** is incorrect because it is used to refer to people, not things.
